**Prerequisites:** [M01 Python](m01.qmd) · **GPU:** none

| # | Lesson | Level | Status | What you learn |
| :-: | :--- | :--- | :-: | :--- |
| 01 | [Database Setup with Docker (PostgreSQL)](../../M07-SQL%20&%20Databases/01-Database%20Setup%20with%20Docker%20(PostgreSQL).ipynb) | 🟢 Beginner | ✅ | Start PostgreSQL with Docker Compose, load the Chinook sample database, connect with psql and SQLAlchemy, explore the catalog. |
| 02 | [Relational Database Foundations](../../M07-SQL%20&%20Databases/02-Relational%20Database%20Foundations.ipynb) | 🟢 Beginner | ✅ | Tables, keys and relationships in Chinook, constraints rejecting bad data, normalisation measured on a denormalised copy. |
| 03 | [Data Definition and Schema Design (CREATE-ALTER)](../../M07-SQL%20&%20Databases/03-Data%20Definition%20and%20Schema%20Design%20(CREATE-ALTER).ipynb) | 🟢 Beginner | ✅ | PostgreSQL data types, CREATE TABLE with constraints, ALTER TABLE and migrations, DELETE vs TRUNCATE timed. |
| 04 | [SQL Query Fundamentals (SELECT, WHERE, GROUP BY)](../../M07-SQL%20&%20Databases/04-SQL%20Query%20Fundamentals%20(SELECT,%20WHERE,%20GROUP%20BY).ipynb) | 🟢 Beginner | ✅ | SELECT, WHERE, NULL handling, ORDER BY, GROUP BY/HAVING and the logical query order on Chinook. |
| 05 | [Joins and Set Operations](../../M07-SQL%20&%20Databases/05-Joins%20and%20Set%20Operations.ipynb) | 🟢 Beginner | ✅ | Inner/outer/cross/self joins, anti-joins, the fan-out trap, UNION/INTERSECT/EXCEPT on Chinook. |
| 06 | [Subqueries and Common Table Expressions (CTEs)](../../M07-SQL%20&%20Databases/06-Subqueries%20and%20Common%20Table%20Expressions%20(CTEs).ipynb) | 🟡 Intermediate | ✅ | Scalar, IN, EXISTS and correlated subqueries, multi-step CTEs, RFM segmentation, recursive org chart. |
| 07 | [Window Functions for Analytics](../../M07-SQL%20&%20Databases/07-Window%20Functions%20for%20Analytics.ipynb) | 🟡 Intermediate | ✅ | OVER/PARTITION BY, running totals, moving averages, RANK/ROW_NUMBER/NTILE, LAG/LEAD growth rates. |
| 08 | [Analytical SQL with DuckDB](../../M07-SQL%20&%20Databases/08-Analytical%20SQL%20with%20DuckDB.ipynb) | 🟡 Intermediate | ✅ | Row vs column stores, DuckDB on SQLite/CSV/Parquet/DataFrames, benchmark vs pandas and SQLite, partitioned exports. |
| 09 | [Connecting Python to SQL (SQLAlchemy & Pandas)](../../M07-SQL%20&%20Databases/09-Connecting%20Python%20to%20SQL%20(SQLAlchemy%20&%20Pandas).ipynb) | 🟡 Intermediate | ✅ | Engines and transactions, SQL injection vs parameters, read_sql chunks, the ORM, bulk loading with COPY measured. |
| 10 | [Indexes and Query Performance](../../M07-SQL%20&%20Databases/10-Indexes%20and%20Query%20Performance.ipynb) | 🟡 Intermediate | ✅ | EXPLAIN ANALYZE, B-tree indexes, selectivity and plan choice, composite/covering indexes, write cost of indexes. |
| 11 | [Transactions and ACID Principles](../../M07-SQL%20&%20Databases/11-Transactions%20and%20ACID%20Principles.ipynb) | 🟡 Intermediate | ✅ | ACID, savepoints, lost updates with 8 threads, FOR UPDATE vs atomic updates, isolation levels, deadlocks. |
| 12 | [NoSQL Databases & MongoDB Fundamentals](../../M07-SQL%20&%20Databases/12-NoSQL%20Databases%20&%20MongoDB%20Fundamentals.ipynb) | 🟡 Intermediate | ✅ | NoSQL models, real MongoDB with Chinook invoices as documents, CRUD, aggregation pipelines, embedding vs referencing, indexes. |
| 13 | [Redis & Key-Value Stores](../../M07-SQL%20&%20Databases/13-Redis%20&%20Key-Value%20Stores.ipynb) | 🟡 Intermediate | ✅ | Redis data structures, TTL, cache-aside in front of PostgreSQL measured, rate limiting, sorted-set leaderboards. |
| 14 | [PostgreSQL JSONB & pgvector](../../M07-SQL%20&%20Databases/14-PostgreSQL%20JSONB%20&%20pgvector.ipynb) | 🟡 Intermediate | ✅ | JSONB queries and GIN indexes, embeddings with Ollama nomic-embed-text, semantic album search, HNSW speed and recall. |
| 15 | [Data Modeling for Analytics (Star schemas)](../../M07-SQL%20&%20Databases/15-Data%20Modeling%20for%20Analytics%20(Star%20schemas).ipynb) | 🟡 Intermediate | ✅ | Facts, dimensions and grain, a Chinook star schema with a date dimension, star vs normalised queries, SCD type 2. |
| 16 | [Security, Roles, and Access Control](../../M07-SQL%20&%20Databases/16-Security,%20Roles,%20and%20Access%20Control.ipynb) | 🟡 Intermediate | ✅ | Roles and grants, column privileges, masking views, row-level security for tenants, privilege audits. |
| 17 | [Stored Procedures, Functions, and Triggers](../../M07-SQL%20&%20Databases/17-Stored%20Procedures,%20Functions,%20and%20Triggers.ipynb) | 🟡 Intermediate | ✅ | SQL and PL/pgSQL functions, batch procedures with COMMIT, audit/validation triggers, trigger overhead measured. |
| 18 | [Backup, Recovery, and Replication](../../M07-SQL%20&%20Databases/18-Backup,%20Recovery,%20and%20Replication.ipynb) | 🟡 Intermediate | ✅ | RPO/RTO, pg_dump formats, tested restores, recovering deleted rows from a dump, WAL, PITR and replication. |
| 19 | [Cloud Data Warehouses (BigQuery Sandbox)](../../M07-SQL%20&%20Databases/19-Cloud%20Data%20Warehouses%20(BigQuery%20Sandbox).ipynb) | 🟡 Intermediate | ✅ | Warehouse architecture and pricing, bytes-scanned cost estimation, partitioning and clustering measured with Parquet, BigQuery SQL. |
| 20 | [Text-to-SQL with Open LLMs](../../M07-SQL%20&%20Databases/20-Text-to-SQL%20with%20Open%20LLMs.ipynb) | 🟠 Advanced | ✅ | Schema prompts, safe execution (read-only, timeout), execution accuracy on 16 labelled Chinook questions with Llama 3.2 3B. |
